title: Portfolio Deduction for Businesses Holding a Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contract: Small Business Electricity Supply Termination Fees
content:
A business may hold, besides its small business sites, a large-facility contract under Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts. That holding bears on the early termination fee of its Small Business Electricity Supply agreements.

**Portfolio deduction.** When the business holds an active Beacon Ridge commercial and industrial contract with 12 or more whole months from the handling date to that contract's end date, 40.00 dollars are deducted; when it holds an active one with fewer than 12 whole months left, 20.00 dollars are deducted; when it holds no active one, nothing is deducted.

## Records read

The business's Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts records: whether one is in active status, and that contract's end date. The contract need not be at the same site as the small business agreement. Whole months run by calendar month from the handling date to the contract end date, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached.

| Business's Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts holding | Portfolio deduction |
|---|---|
| active, 12 or more whole months to its end date | 40.00 USD |
| active, fewer than 12 whole months to its end date | 20.00 USD |
| none active (for example only pending, or expired) | none |

## Boundary (hypothetical handling date 4 October 2026)

| Active contract's end date | Whole months left | Deduction |
|---|---|---|
| 3 October 2027 | 11 | 20.00 USD |
| 4 October 2027 | 12 | 40.00 USD |

**Hypothetical.** A business handled on 4 October 2026 whose active commercial and industrial contract ends 31 March 2029 has 29 whole months left: 40.00 USD are deducted.
